title: SytexLanguage
description: Remove language barriers on your server! A modern, lightweight, and easy-to-use multi-language management system.
body:
# SytexLanguage - Real-time Chat Translator

SytexLanguage is a lightweight, client-side translation mod designed to break the language barrier on international Minecraft servers! It translates incoming and outgoing chat messages seamlessly between English and Turkish.

✨ Features

Incoming Chat Translation: Automatically detects and translates incoming player and server messages, displaying the translated Turkish version discreetly below the original text with a [TR] tag.

Quick Outgoing Translation (Ctrl + G): Type in your native language, highlight the text, and press Ctrl + G. Your message is instantly translated to English, ready to be sent!

Zero Lag / FPS Friendly: All translation requests are handled on a separate background thread, ensuring absolutely zero impact on your FPS or ping.

Client-Side Only: You don't need the server to have this mod installed. Drop it into your mods folder and use it on any multiplayer server!

⚙️ How to Use?

Open the chat and type your message.

Highlight the text you want to translate (e.g., using Ctrl + A).

Press Ctrl + G to instantly replace the text with its translated English version. Hit Enter to send!
